usage: 燒賣 is used as a countable noun to refer to a type of traditional steamed dim sum.
You can use 燒賣 when ordering food to specify this particular dish.
燒賣 is often the subject or object in sentences talking about food or meals.
It can be used in both singular and plural forms when counting—e.g., one siu mai or some siu mai.
燒賣 can appear with measure words like '籠' (tray/basket) or '隻' (piece) when quantifying.
